text_block_list.text: She's been working hard in her races lately, so I came to buy some celebratory sweets, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Jiggly pudding,
and cake loaded with whipped cream...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Even though I can eat my favorite sweets,
I have completely lost my appetite...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It's good that you aren't overeating, but...
I must admit, I'm a bit shocked.

It seems fatigue is still lingering.
For the sake of her future success, should I reconsider her upcoming race schedule...?
